mapper.select: SELECT ast12_book_real_id AS book_real_id , ast12_hold_date AS hold_date , ast12_ast_class_tree_id AS ast_class_tree_id , ast12_item_s_class_nm AS item_s_class_name , ast12_corp_nm AS corp_name , ast12_ast_class_tree_nm AS ast_class_tree_name , ast12_cur_cd AS cur_code , ast12_real_amt AS real_amt , ast12_real_for_amt AS real_for_amt , ast12_rcnt_amt AS rcnt_amt , ast12_rcnt_for_amt AS rcnt_for_amt , ast12_note AS note FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(a.ast12_book_real_id, f_create_seq()) as ast12_book_real_id , ast01_company_id as ast12_company_id , CAST(#{holdDate} AS date) as ast12_hold_date , ast01_class_tree_id as ast12_ast_class_tree_id , COALESCE(a.ast12_real_amt, 0) as ast12_real_amt , COALESCE(a.ast12_real_for_amt, 0) as ast12_real_for_amt , a.ast12_note as ast12_note , f_get_corp_nm(ast01_corp_id) as ast12_corp_nm , ast01_class_tree_nm as ast12_ast_class_tree_nm , COALESCE(ast01_cur_cd,'KRW') as ast12_cur_cd , ast01_item_m_class_cd as ast12_item_m_class_cd , ast01_item_s_class_cd as ast12_item_s_class_cd , f_cdnm('ItemSClassCode',ast01_item_s_class_cd,ast01_company_id,#{holdDate}) as ast12_item_s_class_nm , ast01_seq as ast12_seq , COALESCE(b.ast12_real_amt , 0) as ast12_rcnt_amt , COALESCE(b.ast12_real_for_amt, 0) as ast12_rcnt_for_amt FROM ast01_class_tree LEFT OUTER JOIN ast12_book_real a ON ( a.ast12_company_id = ast01_company_id AND a.ast12_ast_class_tree_id = ast01_class_tree_id AND a.ast12_hold_date = #{holdDate} ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ast12_book_real b ON ( b.ast12_company_id = ast01_company_id AND b.ast12_ast_class_tree_id = ast01_class_tree_id AND b.ast12_hold_date = ( SELECT MAX(ast12_hold_date) FROM ast12_book_real WHERE ast12_company_id = ast01_company_id AND ast12_hold_date < #{holdDate} ) ) WHERE ast01_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast01_type_cd = 'IT' AND ast01_asset_type = '1' /* (1:고유자산) */ AND ast01_item_l_class_cd = '10' /* (10:현금 및 예치금) */ AND /*(2023-08-18 CYY - 청약예치계좌 제외)*/ ast01_item_s_class_cd NOT IN ( SELECT sys09_code FROM sys13_code_group INNER JOIN sys09_code ON sys09_code_id = sys13_code_id WHERE sys13_kind_group_cd = 'ItemSClassCode004' ) AND COALESCE(ast01_mat_date,'9999-12-31') >= #{holdDate} AND COALESCE(ast01_use_yn,'false') = 'true' ) t WHERE CONCAT(ast12_corp_nm,ast12_ast_class_tree_nm,ast12_cur_cd) ILIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY ast12_item_m_class_cd, ast12_item_s_class_cd, ast12_seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ast12_book_real ( ast12_book_real_id, ast12_company_id, ast12_hold_date, ast12_ast_class_tree_id, ast12_keep_account_id , ast12_real_qty, ast12_real_amt, ast12_real_for_amt, ast12_note ) VALUES ( #{req.bookRealId}, #{companyId}, #{holdDate}, #{req.astClassTreeId}, #{req.astClassTreeId} , #{realQty}, #{req.realAmt}, #{req.realForAmt}, #{req.note} )
